title: About

This is a template page for your site. Edit this file to add information about your survey template, your project, or your organization.

## Features

- Clean, modern design inspired by Real World Data Science
- Fully customizable color scheme
- Responsive layout that works on all devices
- Built with Quarto for easy maintenance
- Professional typography with Oswald and Montserrat fonts

## Getting Started

1. Customize the `_quarto.yml` file with your site title, URLs, and navigation
2. Edit `index.qmd` to modify the homepage
3. Update the color scheme by editing `rwds.css`
4. Add your own pages by creating new `.qmd` files

## Learn More

Visit the [Quarto documentation](https://quarto.org) to learn more about building websites with Quarto.
